##1. `/Users/hdragon689/Documents/MyDoc_iCloud/packages/stamps/stamps_v3/stamps/stamps/graph/__init__.py`

This module **defines no symbols**; it re-exports plotting helpers from `categorical`. Public names (see `__all__`):

| Name | Signature | Brief description |
|------|-----------|-------------------|
| `plot_cross_section` | *(imported)* | Lithology vs horizontal coordinate (cross-section scatter). |
| `plot_borehole_locations` | *(imported)* | Plan-view borehole map; optional OSM basemap. |
| `plot_depth_slices` | *(imported)* | Plan-view categorical maps at several depths. |
| `plot_pmodel_matrix` | *(imported)* | Full \(n_c \times n_c\) transition-probability matrix (empirical + fitted). |
| `plot_pmodel_self_transitions` | *(imported)* | Vertical vs horizontal self-transition curves. |
| `plot_xgb_prior` | *(imported)* | Per-class ML prior maps at one depth. |
| `plot_estimation_maps` | *(imported)* | MAP lithology maps (methods × depths). |
| `plot_posterior_maps` | *(imported)* | Per-class posterior maps at one depth. |
| `plot_loocv_bar` | *(imported)* | Bar chart of LOOCV accuracy / mean log-likelihood / optional balanced accuracy. |

## 2. `/Users/hdragon689/Documents/MyDoc_iCloud/packages/stamps/stamps_v3/stamps/stamps/graph/categorical.py`

**Public** (`__all__`); full signatures:

```python
def plot_cross_section(
    x, z, litho_codes,
    categories, labels, colors,
    x_label="Easting (m)",
    title="Cross-section: lithology vs easting",
    s=4, alpha=0.6,
    ax=None, figsize=(8, 4),
)

def plot_borehole_locations(
    well_xy, station_ids, well_depths=None,
    osm_background=True, crs_epsg=3826,
    title=None,
    ax=None, figsize=(7, 7),
)

def plot_depth_slices(
    x, y, z, litho_codes,
    categories, labels, colors,
    z_targets=(-15, -75, -150), dz=5.0,
    osm_background=False, crs_epsg=3826,
    suptitle="Borehole lithology at depth levels",
    figsize=None,
)

def plot_pmodel_matrix(
    D_emp, P_emp, O_emp,
    dmodel, Pmodel,
    categories, labels, colors,
    x_label="Separation",
    suptitle=None,
    ylim=(0, 0.5),
    figsize=None,
)

def plot_pmodel_self_transitions(
    D_v, P_v, O_v, dmodel, Pmodel,
    D_h, P_h, O_h, dmodel_h, Pmodel_h,
    labels, colors,
    x_scale_h=1e3,
    x_unit_h="km",
    suptitle="Vertical vs Horizontal Pmodel — self-transition",
    figsize=(14, 5),
)

def plot_xgb_prior(
    ck, prior_matrix, well_xy,
    z_level, categories, labels,
    dz=1.0,
    cmap="RdYlGn",
    suptitle=None,
    figsize=None,
)

def plot_estimation_maps(
    ck, map_arrays, method_names,
    categories, labels, colors,
    z_levels=None,
    dz=1.0,
    s=18,
    suptitle="MAP lithology — separable 3-D estimation",
    figsize=None,
)

def plot_posterior_maps(
    ck, posterior,
    well_xy,
    z_level, categories, labels,
    dz=1.0,
    cmap="RdYlGn",
    suptitle=None,
    figsize=None,
)

def plot_loocv_bar(
    method_names, accuracies, mean_log_likelihoods,
    balanced_accuracies=None,
    colors=("steelblue", "seagreen", "darkorange"),
    suptitle="Station LOOCV",
    figsize=None,
)
```

**Descriptions:** module docstring (lines 17–27) matches the table above: cross-section, boreholes, depth slices, Pmodel matrix/self-transitions, XGB prior maps, MAP maps, posterior maps, LOOCV bars. All return `fig` and `ax`/`axes` for further use.

**Non-public helpers:** `_legend_patches`, `_add_osm` (OSM via contextily/pyproj).

## 5. `/Users/hdragon689/Documents/MyDoc_iCloud/packages/stamps/stamps_v3/stamps/stamps/stest/analysis.py`

**Exists.** First ~200 lines include module docstring (homogeneous regions for nonstationary BME; backends `hierarchical`, `kmeans`, `dbscan`; output aligned with `fit_regional_pmodels`).

**Public** (`__all__`):

```python
def identify_homogeneous_regions_data(
    coords: np.ndarray,
    data_vectors: np.ndarray,
    n_regions: Optional[int] = None,
    method: str = "hierarchical",
    linkage_method: str = "ward",
    weights: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None,
    min_samples_per_region: int = 5,
    standardize: bool = True,
    spatial_connectivity: bool = False,
    connectivity_k: Optional[int] = None,
    connectivity_scale=None,
    eps: Optional[float] = None,
    min_dbscan_samples: int = 3,
    return_extras: bool = False,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> Union[
    Tuple[np.ndarray, Dict[str, Any]],
    Tuple[np.ndarray, Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]],
]
```

**Brief description:** Builds a joint z-scaled feature space from coordinates and compositional/data vectors, clusters with the chosen method, optionally enforces spatial connectivity (k-NN graph), merges small regions, returns region labels (+ metadata dict, optional extras).

**Private in first 200 lines:** `_merge_small_regions`, `_relabel_contiguous`, `_build_connectivity`, `_apply_connectivity_scale`.
